subject: Discovery follow-up: schedule evaluation kickoff & technical deep-dive
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
To: Akiko Tanaka <akiko@okai.ai>, Kenji Sato <kenji.s@okai.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 9 Apr 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery follow-up: schedule evaluation kickoff & technical deep-dive

Hi Akiko / Kenji —

Thanks again for the time today — good conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can lock a kickoff/demo slot next week: 

Recap (notes from today)
- Primary use case: on-device inference orchestration for customer support summarization (short-form transcripts, 1–3k tokens).
- Success metrics you called out: median generation latency <150ms on your target hardware, inference cost per 1k tokens <$0.12, and >90% pass rate on targeted prompt set for hallucination checks.
- Current constraints: running mixed CPU/GPU fleet, want private deployment (VPC) for PII data, and need SOC 2 evidence for procurement.

Proposed next meeting: evaluation kickoff (45–60m) that combines a technical deep-dive + trial plan walkthrough. Please pick one of these slots (all times PT):
- Tue Apr 13, 09:00–09:45
- Tue Apr 13, 13:00–13:45
- Wed Apr 14, 08:30–09:15

Agenda (draft)
- Intros & architecture alignment (10m)
- Technical deep-dive: runtime, VPC/Private options, quantization/latency knobs (15–20m)
- Trial plan & success criteria walk-through (10m)
- Open questions & next steps (5–10m)

Prework request
- If you can, please share a representative prompt set (10–20 prompts) and a small sample transcript we can use for latency/cost estimates.

I've attached a one-page mutual action plan (MAP) and a trial success criteria template to help frame the kickoff. If a slot above works, I will send a calendar invite and attach a draft MAP with owners.

Thanks — looking forward to continuing.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0182
Redwood Inference

Thanks Aditya — really helpful summary. We’re excited to move forward.

Kenji and I can do Tue Apr 13 at 09:00 PT (that works best for our Tokyo and SF folks). Attendees from our side: Akiko (Product), Kenji (Engineering), plus Jun Nakamura (Infra) — I’ll add them to the invite if that slot is confirmed.

Couple quick questions before the kickoff:
- Does Redwood’s Private deployment support our air-gapped/on-prem option or is VPC-only available at kickoff?
- Can you share SOC 2 Type II evidence (or a security pack) during the kickoff so procurement can begin a review?

We’ll also get a small prompt sample to you by EOD Monday (Apr 12).

—Akiko
